scenes.title: Level 2: First notes
scenes.subtitle: Frets, fingers and melodies
lines: Learn finger numbers, play C, D, E, F and G on the top two strings, and make your first melody — Ode to Joy by Beethoven.

scenes.heading: In this level
lines: After this level, you'll place your fingers correctly on the top two strings, play five notes — C, D, E, F and G — and use them to play two short melodies: 'Ode to Joy' and 'Twinkle, Twinkle'.
You'll also reach the A note on the fifth fret of the top string.
Let's start with 'Frets and fingers' — learn finger numbers and how to play clean, clear notes on the guitar.
